info.name: University Record Service - Local lab
info.description: Run the entire collection in order against the local lab implementation. POST /applicants consumes the repeatable mocked ApplicantInitialized story; it is not a real story-generator call. Captures applicantId automatically. Replays do not replace stored ground truth. Uses public mock session tokens and the fixed reference data documented in the service README. No Session call, real JWT validation, RabbitMQ or shared-stack integration is assumed. Change recordsBaseUrl if necessary. Do not create environment variables shadowing generated collection IDs. Academic-year needs authentication but never an assignment. Error requests count as passing tests when their expected status/envelope matches.
